triage.question: How hard is it to fix this failed check of a Java build? Judge the work a fix needs, not how scary the message looks.

levels.trivial: Mechanical or an obvious one-line edit: formatting, an unused import, a license header, a missing semicolon, a misspelled name. The message names the exact fix.
levels.simple: A small fix in one or two files that needs a little reading: a style or analyzer finding, a type or signature change at a few call sites, one failing test whose cause is visible in the message.
levels.average: A few classes or tests change together, or tests must be added: a coverage threshold missed, two related tests that disagree, a mapping or serialization change.
levels.hard: Real investigation: many failing tests with one shared cause, concurrency, flaky, timing or order-dependent failures, memory, a migration, or a build-wide change.
